newsitem.title: GERMANY: HELLMANN NAMES NEW EUROPE AIRFREIGHT MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: HELLMANN NAMES NEW EUROPE AIRFREIGHT MANAGER.

text.p: Freight forwarder Gebrueder Hellmann GmbH & Co KG said it has appointed Gerhard Fleissner as airfreight general manager Europe.
Fleissner, formerly airfreight director of Thyssen Haniel Logistic International GmbH, will be responsible for global product development for the Hellmann group of partners, a statement said.
The Hellmann network, with 368 offices in 128 countries, has also extended its presence in northern and eastern Europe with two new partners.

These are Danish freight forwarder Chr. Jensen A/S, with outlets in Russia, Estonia and Latvia, and Slovenian transport firm Intereuropa Ltd with offices in Croatia, Bosnia and Macedonia. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
